newsitem.title: USA: XTRA Corp sees 1998 capital spending lower.
newsitem.headline: XTRA Corp sees 1998 capital spending lower.

text.p: XTRA Corp said on Tuesday that it expected capital spending for new equipment to drop in fiscal 1998, compared with fiscal 1997 levels.
The company, which leases over-the-road trailers and intermodal equipment, attributed the projection to equipment additions in fiscal 1997, many of them slated for the second half of the year.
"Fiscal 1997 committed capital expenditures currently total $254 million of which $193 million is for over-the-road trailers," the company said in a statement.
"Utilization of over-the-road equipment is currently strong at 88 percent and we expect demand for this equipment to remain high," it added.
